asr.full_text: In the morning of the 4th of Gama, a young girl was arrested on crime in Darbul Murin, the police. They have been arresting her since the last morning at late night. The police know that a young girl's body is on the scene, but police said she knew her in a TikTok story. The girl is the boss of a small gang and her husband Rubel. He used to play a mashiich tassels on their back. They made those tiktok videos and posted it on their pages. They were so upset. In the sense that they got in a fight with their husband too and all of of them had gone out and traded some it's the way the men treat me. Translated & Timimah Translated by Rekha Siva
